# Strategy

## Vision
VoltEdge Devices aims to be the leading Texas builder of rugged payment terminals

## Target Customer (ICP)
- Segment: mid-size US retailers and ISOs deploying 100-5,000 payment terminals

## Yearly Goals
- Units shipped: 30,000
- Field return rate: < 3%

## Brand Positioning
Reliable payment hardware with the fastest RMA turnaround in the market
